evals.prompt: Use $thread-stages to give me the exact shell commands to inspect the current thread's saved buttons, replace them with a Review button whose ID is review and prompt is Review this change., hide the thread title, run that button, and later clear all buttons. Explain what happens to existing buttons when replacing them. Do not execute commands that change thread state or send messages.
evals.expected_output: Dedicated sidebar actions commands using --self, a valid JSON array, --hide-title, the saved action ID, and an empty array to clear, with an explanation that set replaces the entire action list.
expectations: Uses dedicated sidebar actions list, set, and run commands with --self.
The replacement has ID review, label Review, prompt Review this change., and --hide-title.
Runs by action ID and clears with an empty JSON array.
Explains that set replaces existing buttons and does not execute state-changing commands.
